newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish minfin sees CPI at 13 pct Dec target -PAP.
newsitem.headline: Polish minfin sees CPI at 13 pct Dec target -PAP.

text.p: Poland's Finance Minister Marek Belka expects year-on-year inflation to fall to the 1997 budget target of 13 percent in December despite the burden of flood relief, PAP news agency said on Friday.
"I see no reasons which would cause inflation not to reach 13 percent (in December)," PAP quoted Belka as saying.
Belka said the economy could withstand the additional cost of the flood relief programme.
"The Polish economy is able to finance the effort to rebuild flooded areas without a more serious economic fallout," he said.

On Thursday, the parliament passed a law that increased the amount of treasury papers the government can sell to the central bank by 2.5 billion zlotys ($720.5 million). It also cleared the way for the government to borrow $300 million from the World Bank.
